description_en: [Deprecated] Queries the SQL Explorer (SQL Audit) logs of an ApsaraDB RDS instance. This API operation is no longer maintained but remains callable
description_zh: 停止维护：可以正常调用，但不再维护。该接口用于查询RDS实例的SQL洞察（SQL审计）日志
name: DescribeSQLLogRecords

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The keywords that are used for the query.

When an audit file is generated by calling the API operation (the Form request parameter is set to File), filtering by keyword is not supported.

Separate multiple keywords with spaces. You can specify up to 10 keywords. The logical relationship between keywords is AND.

If a field name in the SQL statement is enclosed in backticks (\`), you must also include the backticks when you use the field name as a query keyword. For example, if the field name is \`id\`, enter \`id` instead of id.

After you enter keywords, the system matches the keywords based on the Database, User, and QueryKeywords parameters at the same time. The logical relationship among these three request parameters is AND
parameters.help_zh:
用于查询的关键字。

通过API生成审计文件时（请求参数Form取值为File），不支持通过关键字筛选。

多个关键字以空格分隔，不超过10个关键字；各个关键字之间的逻辑关系为and。

如果SQL语句中的字段名使用了反引号（\`），以该字段名作为查询的关键字时，也需要输入反引号。例如，字段名为\`id\`，则输入\`id`，而不是id。

输入关键字后，系统会以Database、User和QueryKeywords同时进行关键字匹配，三个请求参数之间的逻辑关系为and
parameters.name: query_keywords

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. You can query data within the last 7 days from the current date. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If DAS Enterprise Edition V3 is activated and its SQL Explorer and Audit feature is used, you can query data within the hot storage duration. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2778837.html operation to query the activation information of the Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，可查询当前日期7天内的数据。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 当开通了DAS企业版 V3，使用其提供的SQL洞察和审计功能时，可查询数据热存储时长内的数据。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2778837.html可以查询开通的企业版信息
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the database. By default, all databases are queried. You can also enter a database name to query a specific database. You can enter only one database name at a time
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名称。默认为所有数据库，也可以输入数据库名称查询，一次只能输入一个
parameters.name: database

parameters.help_en: The name of the user. By default, all users are queried. You can also enter a username to query a specific user. You can enter only one username at a time
parameters.help_zh: 用户名称。默认为所有用户，也可以输入用户名称查询，一次只能输入一个
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to trigger the generation of an audit file or return a list of SQL records. Valid values:
File: triggers the generation of an audit file and returns only common parameters. You must call the DescribeSQLLogFiles operation to obtain the final download URL of the file.
Stream: returns a list of SQL records. This is the default value.

If the value is set to File, only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances with Premium Local SSDs and ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances are supported, and up to 1 million log entries can be recorded
parameters.help_zh:
触发审计文件的生成或者返回SQL记录列表，取值：
File：若传入这个值，则触发审计文件的生成，只返回公共参数，需再调用DescribeSQLLogFiles接口获取文件的最终下载地址。
Stream：默认值，返回SQL记录列表。

取值为File时，只支持MySQL（高性能本地盘）和SQL Server实例，且最多记录100万条日志
parameters.name: form

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time, and the interval between the start time and the end time must be less than or equal to 7 days. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If DAS Enterprise Edition V3 is activated and its SQL Explorer and Audit feature is used, you can query data within the hot storage duration. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2778837.html operation to query the activation information of the Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，大于查询开始时间，与查询开始时间间隔小于等于7天。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 当开通了DAS企业版 V3，使用其提供的SQL洞察和审计功能时，可查询数据热存储时长内的数据。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2778837.html可以查询开通的企业版信息
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30~100。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any integer greater than 0 and less than or equal to the maximum value of the Integer data type.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

schema.description_en: The details of the response parameters

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of SQL audit logs on the current page
